results.name: Level 50 progression, new node gates and point conservation
Legacy save/load and cap PP settlement preserve XP without duplicate payouts
Rejected Flit spends no charge, only the blocked cue; shortened landing clears the actor radius
Flit VFX draws without shadowBlur and keeps one body per spirit across frames
Held ring flick requires fresh outward speed, rearms deliberately and preserves standalone flick
Precise Stick: dead centre, gentle response curve, and steering that grows with the push
A car turned into a wall or corner can always drive away from it
Player autodrive follows connected roads and arrives without teleport
Zib autodrive follows connected roads and arrives without teleport
Player completes a passed endpoint stop on R0.S0.L2
Player completes a passed endpoint stop on R1.S1.L2
Zib completes a passed endpoint stop on R0.S0.L2
Zib completes a passed endpoint stop on R1.S1.L2
Map-edge dead ends start no ride, keep her pin, and a failed route is free
A map switch mid-ride ends the ride uncharged, with no ghost cab
Player stopped beside the final stop arrives after a still half-second
Zib stopped beside the final stop arrives after a still half-second
Arrival without a drive route keeps the direct-distance threshold
Autodrive keyboard repeat, player takeover and passenger input guards
Closed profiler samples no clocks or reports; visible profiler and benchmark can sample
Player marker keeps CSS-pixel size, hides in special views and restores Canvas state
Mirage rings keep one quarter-resolution snapshot, at most four bends and no outlines
Every rapid-fire bullet that lands deals damage; a melee swing keeps its i-frames
Nav grid: once per tick, local invalidation, failed searches back off, steering falls back straight
Melee steps in only on a target in reach
Pause → Equip opens the Weapons tab and lists the equipped gun; furniture waits for the apartment
Adaptive lighting survives zoom lamp-budget steps and lightning
Baseline layer panel: each layer gated and billed; with Baseline off nothing is gated or counted
Velvet routes around walls without teleporting or walking through geometry
Velvet waits at unreachable routes and leaves rest when the player departs
Velvet is blended as an animal, not a humanoid, so her walk phase stays finite
Contact shadows stay on the ground across rotation, bobbing, vector and sprite passes
Humanoid contact and sun shadows keep their world placement as bodies turn
Furniture sprites: painted runs never change over time, loops repeat per period, stamps follow state
A landmark just off screen still throws its beams but skips its roof pass
A landmark whose body is off screen draws only its beams in the glow pass
Bulb sprites: baked once per screen scale, stamped the same size in the world
Apartment lights: each lamp shade and festoon bulb is one stamp, glow and bulb together
The window city draws nothing while its strip is off screen
City view: the hub kit seen from a window; its bake leaves the camera as it found it, and each car is one stamp
City traffic: the cars on a lane share its speed, and never close on each other
City parallax: the city slides slower than the floor, never past its picture, and sits as laid out at the edge
Look-out: at the veranda edge the camera leans out over the city; nowhere else
Camera edge lock: the view stays inside the map, a narrow map is centred, and off it follows her as before
Ultra reflections: lights at half size, detail at full size and only where it has something, art at the scale it is seen
Ultra reflections: art repaints on a cadence, crowd bakes are shared and pace-proof, puddles bake once, rects never overlap
Adaptive reflections: slow frames step Ultra down to High then Medium (never Off), steady frames bring it back, the saved choice untouched
Device Preset: off by default; on applies this device's tier, a save can't undo it, and off puts every setting back
Rooftop festoons: every bulb at its own shimmer of the string, in one fill per shimmer
Landmark roofs: every painted run draws the same at any time and in any wind
An unmarked plane (the Moon City canopy) stamps as one sprite instead of drawing its art
Cars live on the hub: after a hijack nothing of hers is drawn, solid or offered indoors, and each is back where she left it
Out of a hijacked car: lights left on, still hers to Drive; taking another sends it back to traffic, lit, and an empty one has nobody to put out
Amber's van is sanctioned: never duplicated, parked where she leaves it, home for a new job
Her car on foot: Drive from behind or in front walks round the corner without a stall; walking into it slides along its side like any car
Markers: pins over what is on screen after the light; the compass round her for what is not; none indoors
The package: drawn by the van and lit at night, picked up there or loaded with the van; the readout follows the job
Hijacking: a ganger at the wheel comes out fighting; a civilian, or an empty car, does not
Traffic goes round her parked car: a lane change, or a stop and an overtake when both lanes are hers; never a shove
People in the road: someone crossing is let across, someone standing is stopped for and gone round at a walk; nobody is touched
Tempers: the calm wait longer and give more room than the pushy; walled in, a car backs up and waits (the pushy on the horn), never pushes
Street pedestrians: one standing in the lane is gone round; one on the pavement by the kerb never slows a car
Hit by a car: 10 once, then a moment of grace, not a hit every tick it touches
Parked on its nose: a car backs up off her car, then goes round it without a touch
Junction lights follow demand: green rests on its road while the other is empty, and turns for the first car that waits
Junction lights: a red is stopped for at the line behind the crosswalk; amber stops the calm, the pushy run it
Junction lights: right turns only from the kerb lane, and a kerb right turn goes with the car going straight beside it
Junction lights: a left turn waits for what is coming the other way; nobody goes into a box whose way out is full
Pedestrians walk on: turn back only at a dead end or full crossing, never re-cross straight back, and connect block ends
Junction lights: a turn arrow lets waiting turns go before the straight-on traffic, and frees a left turn stuck on a green
Walkers at junction lights wait at the kerb for the walk (asking for it), then cross; crossings join the pavement
A busy junction moves more cars with the lights than with the old one-at-a-time queue, and nobody touches
Saves from the old city: a spot where a building stands now loads at the spawn, her car where it waits in a new game
Saves: her car stays where she parked it through a save made indoors; a hijacked drive loads on foot
Garage switch while out in a hijacked car keeps her in it, and the old model leaves no invisible wall
Visibility: her halo by day, by night and in night vision (and off with Player Glow off); only hostiles burn white in night vision
City: no building, portico, forecourt or drive in the hub reaches a pavement or road
City helpers: the hand-laid block has its shop parade wall to wall on Hotel Dr., and no building overlaps another
Doors any side: a building faces the street it is placed on, door, sign, lights, landmark and Zib drop-off with it
The bigger city: four times the old area, near square, every landmark placed clear of the street and reachable by Zib and autodrive
Street-front fill: auto-filled blocks grow rows along the streets they front, facing the road
Angled streets: Lantern Cut joins its roads at shaped junctions, with pavements, crossings, walks and buildings to match
The newer city's angled and curved streets: Foxglove Cut is built like the first ones
The newer city's angled and curved streets: Starling Diagonal is built like the first ones
The newer city's angled and curved streets: Crescent Row is built like the first ones
The newer city's angled and curved streets: Velvet Hook is built like the first ones
Curved streets: Halfmoon Bend joins its roads at shaped junctions, with pavements, crossings, walks and buildings round the bend
Angled streets: cars drive Lantern Cut and turn in and out at both ends
Curved streets: cars slow for Halfmoon Bend, keep to their lanes round it and turn in and out at both ends
Junction turns curve straight into the lane out: no swing the other way first, on square, angled and curved streets
Overhead: a tall thing hides whoever stands behind it, and draws under whoever stands in front
Overhead: a shelf right beside her draws again over its own footprint, so her arms go behind it
Every bundled map loads, updates and draws without runtime errors
Thigh-high finishes buy, replace footwear and persist alongside thigh bands
Every registered gun hits across muzzle distances and spatial-cell boundaries
YourGirlSara sweeps a crossed cell and damages each target only once
A long sniper barrel cannot spawn its shot beyond a point-blank enemy
A long sniper barrel cannot spawn beyond a solid prop
Sniper hits remain reliable over long ranges, diagonals, and reversed directions
Penetration hits the nearest targets first, regardless of enemy-array order
A nonpenetrating shot stops at its first enemy and records the impact position
Thin walls stop ordinary rounds in travel order, allowing hits before the wall
Rotated solid props block crossed shots, and rounded corners do not produce false hits
Moving enemies are tested at the matching time along the bullet path
A newly spawned round cannot hit an enemy that crossed its muzzle before the shot existed
An enemy round hits a player crossing its path during the same tick
A shot can hit on its last lifetime tick
Removing a hit projectile does not silently remove a different live round
A custom impact that destroys a piercing shot stops further contacts
Swept hits work outside the rendering and physics camera margin
Enemy callbacks keep bullet i-frame bypass for stationary and moving rounds
Doors are resolved in travel order and reduce only hits beyond a penetrated leaf
Glass at a wall surface shatters before the ordinary round stops there
A swept Golden Child hit attaches one orb and preserves its damage snapshot
A reused projectile clears its previous swept path and collision tick
Low render rates and capped catch-up preserve sniper collision hits
Props are found by cell: a far crate, a moved crate and a turned one still stop a shot

verificationKind: Original Node/VM regression suite; not real-browser or phone performance proof
